patch_description:
This design retains the useful rotation-and-entanglement pattern of the seed while replacing its independently parameterized, line-connected block with a permutation-equivariant collective circuit. Each rotation layer shares one parameter across all eight qubits, matching the symmetry of the 28-pair feature map and mean-Z readout. This reduces the total parameter count from 146 to 20, which should improve parameter efficiency and reduce overfitting.

A complete-graph CZ layer supplies symmetric nonlinear interactions. Its edges are ordered as seven disjoint round-robin matchings, minimizing entangling depth despite all-to-all connectivity. The block begins with collective RY mixing and ends with RZ followed by RX: the final non-diagonal RX converts accumulated feature-dependent phases into measurable Z populations and avoids terminal diagonal parameters that cannot influence the readout. Consecutive repetitions also remain noncommuting rather than collapsing into a single rotation.
